# @hyperdart/sandbox

Sandbox for dart development and testing on localhost

## Installation

```sh
npm install --save @hyperdart/sandbox
```

## Usage

```jsx
import React from 'react'
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom'
import { HDSandbox } from '@hyperdart/sandbox'
import hDConfig from 'hd-test-component/hyperdart.config'
import defaultSearchData from 'hd-test-component/searchData.json'

ReactDOM.render(<HDSandbox config={hDConfig} searchData={defaultSearchData}/>, document.getElementById('root'))
```
